key_insight: DexNinja learns robust dexterous cutting by converting a small number of real demonstrations into a much denser, physically plausible real-to-sim-to-real training set.
engineering_relevance: The framework reduces the data cost of training robotic manipulation policies for deformable, topology-changing materials such as food while improving transfer from simulation to real hardware.
method: Reconstructs food object instances from real captures to build realistic initial states.
Randomizes physically meaningful material and contact parameters under category-level constraints.
Generates augmented cutting episodes with a custom differentiable simulator coupling robot dynamics, tactile contact, and deformable cutting.
evidence_signal: Using tens of real demonstrations plus hundreds of augmented simulation samples, the policy achieved over 60% success and improved real-only training by more than 20% via sim-to-real augmentation.
watch_item: Performance may still depend on simulator fidelity for contact, friction, and cutting physics, which are difficult to model accurately for varied deformable foods.
paper_title: DexNinja: Learning Robust Dexterous Cutting Policy with a Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Engine
